EC1: 1. Peritonitis [OR] or recovery from peritonitis for less than one month.
EC2: 2. On any intra peritoneal treatment apart from peritoneal dialysis.
EC3: 3. Evidence of decompensated liver cirrhosis [OR] or heart failure.
EC4: 4. Evidence of extra peritoneal leakage, eg. leakage to thoracic cavity, post peritoneal, [OR] hernia.
